rows.label: tlk70000015_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Maam is suspicious of
Makumaku-san, but I think
Makumaku-san can be trusted.

rows.label: tlk70000015_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Since Macmac-san came, the shopping
district's atmosphere changed again.
It's no longer Morumo's one-man show.

rows.label: tlk70000015_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Everyone has started attending the
Chamber of Commerce meetings
regularly too.

rows.label: tlk70000015_05_msg0004
rows.name:
It's true that better communication
has improved a lot of things, but
people are just more invested now.

rows.label: tlk70000015_05_msg0005
rows.name:
And... I think Makumaku-san is the one
who planted that seed.
